title: The photo
old_caption: Take one, Scorpio stepped out of frame. Take two, Leo found its good side and nobody else fit. Take three is the one going on the fridge. Who is always half out of your family photo?

title: The gift you forgot
old_caption: Aquarius forgot the gift, tried a wrapped spoon, then a pinecone with a bow, then just told the truth and fixed Grandma's lamp. Best present in the room. What's the best gift you got that wasn't a thing?

title: The game that got too competitive
old_caption: Round one was friendly. By round three there was a strategy binder, three notepads and two cousins hiding under the table, and Grandma still won. Who gets too competitive at your game night?

title: Cooking together
old_caption: Taurus tasted everything, Cancer followed the recipe card to the letter, and the flour went everywhere. Grandma's last line fixed it. In the kitchen, are you the taster or the measurer?

title: The quiet walk after dinner
old_caption: The house hit max volume, so Scorpio and Pisces went for a walk under Orion and finally said the nervous part out loud. Pisces cried, obviously. Where do you have your best talks?

title: The call to a friend who stayed in town
old_caption: Virgo called the friend who stayed in the city, the whole family crowded in to wave, and Grandma had questions about dinner. A plate is officially saved. Who are you calling this holiday?

title: Leaving early, kindly
old_caption: Option one was vanishing. Option two was a forty-minute goodbye in the doorway. Capricorn picked option three and left with a tower of leftovers. How do you leave a party early?

title: The drive home debrief
old_caption: The drive home: one hard part, one best part, and a recipe card from Grandma that nearly made Leo miss the turn. What's the first thing you ask each other on the way home?

title: Where we're going next year
old_caption: Split the days, take turns, one very long table, or all twelve families in one day. The finale lands where it should: you pick it together. So where are you two going next year?

title: Do I bring them home this year?
old_caption: Not sure whether to bring them home this year? Ask them first. It's their holiday too, and a plan you make together beats one you guess at alone.
